answer: The millrace runs fast under the wheel, and the millwright stands on the staging with his level. Proof of millwright via waterwheel tally — a wheel the millwright frames only after 19 wheels run true without one wobbling at the axle, each framed by the millwright himself. jade frames the wheel and sets the paddles true. quill greases the axle and turns the wheel by hand. umber opens the sluice and watches the wheel take the water. Nineteen wheels must run true without one wobbling at the axle, and the next still wobbles where the frame ran out of square.
